Job Summary

The WordPress Developer Co-op Student will support the development, maintenance, testing, and continuous improvement of the organization’s WordPress websites and digital platforms. Working under the guidance of experienced team members, the student will assist with WordPress configuration, content management, troubleshooting, quality assurance, accessibility, and web development activities.

The role provides hands-on experience working in a professional web development environment and exposure to WordPress, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs, cloud technologies, accessibility standards, domain management, DNS configuration, SSL certificates, and development workflows. Exposure to Vue.js may also be provided depending on project needs.

Duties and Responsibilities



-  Assist with day-to-day WordPress website maintenance and support.
-  Assist with creating and updating WordPress pages, templates, themes, and plugins.
-  Support front-end development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
-  Assist with basic PHP and WordPress development tasks.
-  Gain experience working with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF).
-  Assist with website testing, troubleshooting, and bug identification.
-  Assist with accessibility testing and remediation, including WCAG-related requirements.
-  Support WordPress plugin and core update testing.
-  Gain exposure to APIs, AWS/Azure, domains, DNS, HTTPS, and SSL certificates.
-  May gain exposure to Vue.js depending on project requirements.
-  Assist with technical documentation, task tracking, and research.
-  Participate in team meetings and collaborate with development team members.

Skills And Qualifications



-  Currently enrolled in a University or College program related to Computer Science, Software Development, Web Development, Information Technology, or a related field.
-  Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and web development concepts.
-  Exposure to WordPress, JavaScript, or PHP is considered an asset.
-  Exposure to Vue.js is considered an asset but is not required.
-  Exposure to Git, AWS/Azure, APIs, DNS, or SSL is considered an asset.
-  Basic awareness of web accessibility or WCAG standards is considered an asset.
-  Strong willingness to learn and develop new technical skills.
-  Good problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
-  Strong attention to detail.
-  Primarily an office and computer-based environment.

-  Assist with developing and maintaining web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC / .NET Core.

-  Build and improve modern user interfaces using Lit Components and modern UI frameworks.

-  Assist with testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and application improvements.

-  Currently enrolled in a University or College program related to Computer Science, Software Development, Web Development, Information Technology, or a related field.
-  Basic knowledge of C# and .NET / .NET Core.
-  Familiarity with ASP.NET MVC and/or .NET Framework MVC.
-  Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS (Bootstrap), JavaScript (JQuery) and TypeScript.
-  Familiarity with modern UI frameworks (Angular, Vue, React) and Lit Components is an asset.
-  Familiarity with AWS (ECS, ECR, S3, SES).
-  Familiarity with Azure DevOps and Git.
-  Basic understanding of REST APIs and relational databases.
-  Strong willingness to learn and work collaboratively in a team.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. Responsibilities

Job Description:



- Work with team members to design and create test plans to understand an AI system's performance.
- Create and execute experiments to understand the performance characteristics of the system under test (SUT).
- Use profiling and/or monitoring tools to assist with the performance characterization of the SUT.
- Collaborate with team members regarding status, project progress, and issue resolution.

Education And Experience Required



- Working toward B.S. in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Software Engineering or equivalent

- Experience with AI clusters using job schedulers (e.g., PBS, Slurm) is a plus

- Experience with GPU profiling using NVIDIA Nsight or AMD rocprof is a plus
- Proficiency with CUDA/ROCm is a plus
- Proficiency with the Linux operating systems, scripting, and knowledge of performance monitoring tools
- Experience with AI industry standard benchmarks (MLPerf) is a plus
- Self-driven, solid work ethic, and motivation
- Ability to multi-task with strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
- Integrity, customer focus, innovation, teamwork, and accountability in daily work
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, multitasking environment
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Mastery of the English language is required.

 Our Company Promise 
 
We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth.  Job Description: 
 Summer 2027 Software Engineering Internships  

 Please print/save the job description because it won’t be available after you apply. 

 To be considered, please ensure that you attach a resume to your application.  

 We ask that you apply with your personal email address rather than your school email (.edu) so we can stay connected about future roles at Southwest.  

 Southwest Airlines is committed to providing Employees with equal opportunities for learning and personal growth. As a Technology Intern, you’ll contribute to real-time projects, collaborate with fellow interns and cross-functional teams, help advance Company initiatives, and support Southwest’s Purpose of connecting People to what’s important in their lives through friendly, reliable, and low-cost air travel. Throughout the internship, you’ll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and develop as a future professional while making a meaningful impact. The Software Engineering Intern should be a strong communicator and collaborator, capable of presenting ideas in both technical and user-friendly terms while helping shape the future of Southwest’s Technology Team. If hired, Interns may be selected to support one of the following Teams: 

 Air Operations - Crew Technology 
 The Crew Technology organization develops and supports applications critical to Southwest Airlines Crew Members. Working with both the Crew Certification and Crew Recovery teams, you'll contribute to quality engineering, test automation, cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, and software modernization efforts across Crew Scheduling, Training, Mobility, Planning, and Recovery systems. This role offers the opportunity to work on highly visible technology initiatives while learning from experienced engineers in a large-scale enterprise environment. 

 Air Operations - Revenue Management Technology 
 The Revenue Management Technology team develops and supports the systems that help Southwest Airlines optimize revenue, inventory, and customer demand forecasting. Team members work with large-scale data, cloud and on-premises technologies, and enterprise applications that power Revenue Management, Southwest.com, and Marketing capabilities. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with data-driven decision-making, forecasting, and technology solutions that directly impact airline performance and profitability. 

 Air Operations - Crew Scheduling 
 The CrewMesh Pod supports Southwest Airlines' Crew Scheduling modernization efforts by developing cloud-native services, APIs, and event-driven solutions that connect critical operational systems. Team members work with modern software engineering practices, cloud technologies, automation, and agile delivery methods to build scalable, reliable solutions that support Crew operations while advancing enterprise modernization initiatives. 

 People & Finance - People and Communications 
 The People and Communications team builds and supports technology platforms enabling Southwest Airlines to engage with Customers and Employees through social, internal, and external communication channels. As a Software Engineer Intern, you'll collaborate with engineers, product teams, and business partners to develop innovative solutions that drive meaningful connections and enhance the Southwest brand. You'll gain hands-on experience with modern technologies, Agile development practices, and enterprise platforms that support customer engagement, employee communications, and collaboration across the Company.  

 Tech & Ground Ops - Tech Ops Parts, Finance and Reliability 
 The Tech Operations Technology team develops and modernizes solutions that support aircraft maintenance, parts management, regulatory compliance, and operational readiness across Southwest Airlines. Team members work with cloud technologies, enterprise applications, data products, automation, and AI-enabled solutions that help improve aircraft availability, operational reliability, and maintenance efficiency. This is an opportunity to contribute to business-critical systems that directly support the safe and efficient return of aircraft to service. 

 Additional Details 
 
• Receive free, unlimited space available travel privileges for yourself (taxes and fees may apply on international travel). 
• Interns will be provided any required equipment, such as a laptop, for the internship. 
• Stipends may be offered based on eligibility and program criteria. 
• The Intern will work full-time as a Software Engineering Intern within the Technology Department. This role is offered as a remote workplace position, which may require travel for trainings, meetings, conferences, etc. Outside of those required visits, the majority of your working time may be spent in an approved remote location, away from our Corporate Campus. Please note, while this is a remote position, there is limited group of states or localities ineligible for Employees to regularly perform their work off-site. Those ineligible locations are: Alaska, California, Colorado, Delaware, Illinois, Iowa, Massachusetts, Maryland, Montana, New Jersey, New Hampshire New York, North Dakota, South Dakota, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Vermont, Washington, West Virginia, and Wyoming, and Puerto Rico.  
• U.S. citizenship or current authorization to work in the U.S. required and no current or future work authorization sponsorship available.    
 We are committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics. 
  
 Duties and Responsibilities   
 The duties and responsibilities of the Software Engineering Intern may include but are not limited to:   
 
• Analyze, design, write program code, test, document, and implement functionally appropriately, technically sound, and well-integrated application systems in accordance with Customer requirements, and organizational methodologies and standards.    
• Respond to production problems and implement immediate resolution efforts across technology areas.    
• Maintain awareness of technology trends in area of responsibility.     
• Meet commitments and deliverables related to participating in projects.    
 Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities   
 
• Coursework or hands-on experience with programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, C#, Python, or Node.js.  
• Coursework or experience with AWS cloud services, including S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge, Redshift, Glue, ECS, and Kinesis.  
• Coursework or experience with event streaming and messaging technologies such as Apache Kafka.  
• Coursework or experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs and microservices.  
• Coursework or experience with Git and version control best practices.  
• Coursework or experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and software deployment processes.  
• Coursework or experience with Agile or Scaled Agile (SAFe) methodologies   
• Ability to stay organized and manage multiple and concurrent assignments under tight deadlines preferred   
• Previous internship or work experience as a Software Engineer Intern within the past 12 months preferred   
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-based, Customer service-oriented environment with a high regard for hospitality   
• Demonstrate programming aptitude and ability for logical and abstract thinking   
• Problem solving ability and strong written/verbal communications skills preferred   
• Works well in a culture that is open, direct, respectful, courteous, and compassionate preferred        
 Time Commitment and Pay  
 
• Join Southwest as a Summer 2027 Intern, with a 12-week internship lasting from May 18 – August 8, 2027. 
• Required: Full-time 40hrs a week. 
• Must maintain a consistent weekly schedule during normal business hours at a max of 8hrs per day. 
• $26 - $30 /hour, corresponding with progress towards degree completion.    
 Education   
 
• High School Diploma, GED or equivalent education required.     
• Progress towards degree, major, or minor in MIS, Business, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or Information Technology, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Business Administration or similar degree.   
• Progress towards a 4-year undergraduate degree or graduate degree is required.  
• To be eligible, you must be currently enrolled as a full-time student (as defined by your university) at the time of application and during the internship.     
• 1-2 semesters remaining at the time the internship ends is preferred.     
• Minimum 2.5 cumulative GPA at the time of application is required.    
 Basic Qualifications   
 
• Must be at least 18 years of age.    
• Must have authorization to work in the United States as defined by the Immigration Reform Act of 1986.    
• You must have a valid U.S. Social Security Number to complete the full hiring process.      
 Southwest Airlines is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

 Shape the Future of Mobility at Nissan: Launch Your Career, Drive Innovation

 We are currently looking for a Digital Products & AI Strategy Intern to join our team in Franklin, TN. Our team is responsible for shaping the future of Nissan's digital customer experience through connected vehicle technologies, data platforms, mobile applications, AI-driven solutions, and digital products. We work at the intersection of technology, business strategy, customer experience, and innovation to create value for Nissan customers and the broader mobility ecosystem. This internship provides hands-on exposure to real-world digital product development, data analytics, AI applications, and connected vehicle technologies while collaborating with product managers, engineers, data teams, and business stakeholders on initiatives that impact millions of customers worldwide.

 A Day in the Life :
 
• Support the evaluation and development of AI and digital product initiatives for Nissan's connected vehicle and mobile ecosystems. 
• Analyze customer, vehicle, and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights. 
• Assist in developing business cases, product roadmaps, and executive presentations for emerging digital capabilities. 
• Conduct market and competitive research on connected vehicle services, mobility trends, AI technologies, and digital customer experiences. 
• Participate in cross-functional projects involving product management, data strategy, customer experience, and technology innovation. 
 Who We’re Looking For: 
 Required: 
 
• Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, Product Management, or a related field. 
• Students entering their Junior, Senior, or Master's program at the start of the upcoming academic term. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and develop actionable insights. 
• Interest in AI, digital products, customer experience, connected vehicles, or emerging technologies. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present ideas and recommendations effectively. 
• Ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously. 
• Experience with data analysis, research, or digital product-related projects is preferred. 
• GPA of 3.0 or above (Candidates will be required to provide an official or unofficial transcript during the application process for verification.) 
• Ability to perform work onsite at Franklin, TN. 
 What You’ll Look Forward to at Nissan: 
 Connection and Collaboration: We offer Business Synergy Teams (ERGs) and opportunities for our employees to strengthen their relationships and meet people from similar and diverse backgrounds to foster a culture of belonging.

 Professional Training and Development: Expand your knowledge and skills through Nissan’s rich innovation offerings, seminars, learning platforms and leadership trainings.

 Nissan is committed to a drug-free workplace. All employment is contingent upon the successful completion of drug and background screenings in accordance with Nissan policies and in compliance with federal, state, and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance. Nissan will consider qualified candidates with arrest or conviction records for employment in a manner consistent with these laws. 

 It is Nissan’s policy to provide Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, gender, military status, disability, or any other status protected by law. Candidates for this position must be legally authorized to work in the United States and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility at the time of hire; Nissan uses E-Verify to validate employment eligibility. 

 NISSAN FOR EVERYONE 

 People are our most valuable assets, and Nissan seeks to maximize the power of each individual member of our team. When everyone belongs, the power of NISSAN is undeniable. Nissan aims to improve business results through a workplace and business that meets the needs of our employees and customer base.

 Nissan is committed to creating a culture where everyone belongs and employees, customers, and partners feel respected, valued, and heard. We have Business Synergy Teams (BSTs) across the Americas that are open to all employees and seek to connect employees through common interests and foster a company culture where all employees feel supported and included.

 Nissan also values inclusion in our business as we respect and recognize the diversity of our customer base and the communities where we do business. We are committed to procuring innovative goods and services, retailing our products, and communicating from a position that will help us continue to offer our customers competitively designed, market-driven products.

 Join us as we carry our commitment to our employees and customers into the future.

About Kinaxis

 Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

• Very strong technical aptitude, with a preference for algorithms, data structures

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

 Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.
